novel_features.name: Vessel dossier
novel_features.description: One-shot due-diligence snapshot of a vessel: identity, recent events, and risk insights merged.
novel_features.rationale: Merges three GFW endpoints (vessel, events, insights) via a local join no single API call returns together.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this first when vetting a vessel — it answers identity + behavior + risk in one call instead of three.

novel_features.name: Risk rollup
novel_features.description: Composite risk signal from GFW Insights indicators plus event patterns (encounters, AIS gaps, port visits).
novel_features.rationale: Correlates Insights with cached event history locally; the API exposes the indicators but not the rollup.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to triage which vessels in a set warrant deeper review.

novel_features.name: Encounter network
novel_features.description: Builds the at-sea meeting graph for a vessel — which other vessels it encountered, when, and where.
novel_features.rationale: Constructs a graph from cached encounter events; the API returns events, never the network.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to surface relationships (e.g. transshipment partners) a single-vessel lookup hides.

novel_features.name: Port-visit pattern
novel_features.description: Aggregates a vessel's port-visit events into a frequency/recency pattern.
novel_features.rationale: Local aggregation over accumulated port-visit events.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to spot anomalous port behavior (sanctioned ports, sudden pattern change).

novel_features.name: Dark-activity flag
novel_features.description: Surfaces AIS-gap and loitering events as a dark-activity signal for a vessel.
novel_features.rationale: Filters cached gap/loitering events into a signal; the raw events exist but the framing doesn't.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to flag possible AIS disabling — a classic sanctions-evasion indicator.

novel_features.name: Watchlist pin
novel_features.description: Pin vessels under active due diligence to a local watchlist (with optional label).
novel_features.rationale: Local watchlist persisted in SQLite; pairs with refresh and since.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to track a set of vessels across sessions; 'watch --list' shows them.

novel_features.name: Watchlist refresh
novel_features.description: Re-pull events and insights for watchlisted vessels under a polite throttle.
novel_features.rationale: Iterates the local watchlist and refreshes cached behavior data.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to bring a watchlist current before a review.

novel_features.name: Recent changes
novel_features.description: Shows new events for watchlisted vessels within a time window.
novel_features.rationale: Time-windowed query over accumulated local event history.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for "what happened to my vessels in the last N days".

narrative.headline: Every GFW vessel-behavior and risk surface on the command line, plus a local cache that turns one-shot lookups into a compounding due-diligence index.
narrative.value_prop: The official GFW SDKs are Python and R libraries; the one community CLI only downloads datasets. gfw-pp-cli is the agent-native, offline-caching CLI for vessel due diligence: search vessels, pull their events and risk insights, and run compound queries no SDK offers — 'vessel dossier' merges identity + events + insights, 'encounters network' maps at-sea meetings, 'vessel gaps' flags dark activity.
narrative.auth_narrative: GFW uses a Bearer token. Create a free token at https://globalfishingwatch.org/our-apis/tokens and set it as GFW_TOKEN. Every command reads GFW_TOKEN from the environment.

quickstart.comment: Health check — confirms GFW_TOKEN is set and the API is reachable.
Find vessels by name/MMSI/IMO/callsign and resolve GFW vessel IDs.
One-shot DD snapshot: identity + recent events + risk insights.
Surface AIS-gap / dark-activity events for a vessel.

troubleshoots.fix: Set GFW_TOKEN (free token at globalfishingwatch.org/our-apis/tokens); run 'gfw-pp-cli doctor'.
Lower --rate-limit or use 'watch refresh' which throttles; bulk pulls should use the bulk-reports flow.

troubleshoots.symptom: Empty events for a known vessel
troubleshoots.fix: Widen the date range and confirm the GFW vessel ID (not MMSI) via 'vessel search'.

narrative.when_to_use: Use gfw-pp-cli when an agent needs a vessel's behavior (encounters, loitering, port visits, fishing) or risk indicators from Global Fishing Watch, or to build a compounding local index of vessels under due diligence. It pairs with gisis-pp-cli (identity/registry) for full vessel due diligence.
anti_triggers: Do not use for vessel registry identity/flag-history — use gisis-pp-cli.
Do not use to render map tiles or imagery — GFW's map-visualization tiles are out of scope.
Do not use for real-time live AIS positions — use an AIS-stream source.
